cohort: The study included 542 nulliparous pregnant women aged 30 years or older who delivered at a hospital in Japan between April 1, 2017, and March 31, 2024.
finding: Multivariate analysis revealed that a history of ART treatment and uterine leiomyoma status significantly increased the likelihood of vacuum-assisted delivery, while advanced maternal age did not.
mod_finding: A history of ART treatment and uterine leiomyoma status were found to significantly affect the likelihood of vacuum-assisted delivery.
